presets.name: Music video punch
presets.description: Chromatic RGB split, an impact camera punch and extra contrast. Glitch is its own preset, so this pack uses the RGB split.

presets.name: Dreamy film
presets.description: Red-orange halation glow, soft highlights, warm light leaks and fine grain.

presets.name: Retro VHS
presets.description: VHS colour bleed with a gentle tape wobble and a soft handheld drift.

presets.name: Noir
presets.description: High-contrast black and white with a heavy vignette and film grain.

presets.name: Teal & orange blockbuster
presets.description: Teal shadows, amber highlights and a punchy contrast curve.

presets.name: Summer haze
presets.description: Golden-hour warmth, a drifting sun flare and soft warm leaks.

presets.name: Night drive
presets.description: Tungsten night grade with a cool streetlight flare passing across the frame.

presets.name: Handheld doc
presets.description: 2383-style print grade with a walking camera sway.
